decision.rationale: I will share only the confirmed OTP failure metric with the telecom operator to coordinate on service impact, not patient contact details, because patient mobile numbers are protected by uae.fl2-2019.art16 and uae.fl2-2019.art4 and no permitted disclosure exception is confirmed. I will activate a fallback channel to keep patients able to access care under dha.pp11.4-18-1. I will review the automated lockouts under dha.pp11.4-18-2 and uae.ai-charter.human-oversight because the fraud alert is suspected and no successful unauthorised login is confirmed.

citations.relevance: Sharing patient mobile numbers with the telecom operator is a disclosure of patient information; Art 16 restricts circulation to health purposes with patient written approval except listed cases, and no such exception is confirmed here.

citations.quote_span: To keep the confidentiality of health data and information by not allowing to circulate them in cases other than the permitted.
citations.relevance: Reinforces that circulating patient account records outside permitted cases is prohibited.

citations.quote_span: Entities must thoroughly investigate the breaches/incidents starting from the point of discovery until closure: aa.. Determine if the breach is related to a violation of PHI.
citations.relevance: Supports reviewing the automated lockouts because the fraud-model alert is suspected, not proven, and no intrusion is confirmed.

citations.quote_span: Human Oversight: The Charter emphasizes the irreplaceable value of human judgment and human oversight over AI, aligning with ethical values and social standards to correct any errors or biases that may arise.
citations.relevance: Supports human review of the automated lockouts before reversing them, since the fraud alert may be erroneous.

uncertainty: Whether the OTP failure spike has a common cause (network, telecom, or portal-side) is unknown.
Whether any patient account was actually accessed without authorisation is unknown.
Whether sharing the OTP failure metric with the telecom operator is permitted under any specific telecom information-sharing rule is unknown; no such rule is in the citable corpus.
